newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: VIB BUYS AMVEST PROPERTY WORTH NLG 200 MLN.
newsitem.headline: VIB BUYS AMVEST PROPERTY WORTH NLG 200 MLN.

text.p: Real estate investment fund VIB NV said on Tuesday it would pay some 200 million guilders in cash for property in the Netherlands acquired from Amvest.
Amvest is a real estate investment company created in January through a merger of the property investment arms of insurer Aegon and pension fund PGGM.
VIB said the property it was acquiring consisted of 15 office buildings and eight business premises which generated gross annual rental income of some 20 million guilders.
VIB said the deal fitted in with its plans to expand its investments in the Netherlands and Amvest's plans to concentrate more on apartments and retail properties.
VIB said the acquisition would raise the value of its property portfolio to some 2.8 billion guilders, of which some 1.5 billion guilders was invested in the Netherlands.
